Data:Acted.yvette.box.moon.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.box.moon.json.desc: Dr Southey, inspired by the stories of St Mihail's Coffin to look into the story of St Columba's sarcophagus, seemed to find what she sought. 'Always the tide,' she said...

Data:Acted.yvette.curse.winter.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.curse.winter.json.desc: Dr Southey had purchased one of the Grunewald articles. What she learnt at Hush House convinced her to dispose of it.

Data:Acted.yvette.intrusion.winter.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.intrusion.winter.json.desc: Dr Southey went to interview Hobson in Kraków - but came first to Hush House to ensure she understood the hazards that might entail.

Data:Acted.yvette.mob.moon.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.mob.moon.json.desc: Dr Southey came to suspect the Reckoner trade in years of life might explain how an ancestor at Brancrug had borne a child so late in life...

Data:Acted.yvette.mystical.winter.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.mystical.winter.json.desc: Dr Southey refused the blandishments of the cult called the Ivory Dawn... but suspected that they honoured her by reason of a 'pre-immortal' in her ancestry.

Data:Acted.yvette.rising.moon.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.rising.moon.json.desc: Dr Southey, troubled by dreams, feared death by water.

Data:Acted.yvette.rite.renewal.moon.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.rite.renewal.moon.json.desc: Dr Southey's patient believed he would be reborn at Gladwyn Lake beneath the moon - and she decided, after visiting Hush House, that it would be futile to try to prevent him from going.'Always the tide...'

Data:Acted.yvette.wound.winter.json.label: Acted: Yvette
Data:Acted.yvette.wound.winter.json.desc: Dr Southey knew that she could never hope to heal the Open Reverend's flesh - but he had been one of her patients, and she thought perhaps he might be again.

Data:Acted.zachary.box.knock.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.box.knock.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield seemed to think he had found the name of the coffin's key, here at Hush House.

Data:Acted.zachary.curse.winter.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.curse.winter.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield concluded obscurely that, in the Grunewald matter, he might have enough to understand the possibilities of clarities, conducivities, and 'ovitic forms'.

Data:Acted.zachary.heist.knock.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.heist.knock.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield was close-mouthed about his suspicions of what had really happened at Oriflamme's, but he did share one hint: 'One door closes, another door opens. And another.'

Data:Acted.zachary.intrusion.knock.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.intrusion.knock.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield opined that Hobson, who had been his friend, might now be his friends. Faced with a choice between 'out' and 'down', he chose 'out'.

Data:Acted.zachary.intrusion.winter.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.intrusion.winter.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield opined that Hobson, who had been his friend, might now be his friends. Faced with a choice between 'out' and 'down', he chose 'down'.

Data:Acted.zachary.mystical.winter.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.mystical.winter.json.desc: It wasn't clear what Zachary Wakefield intended with the new crop of cults... but it was clear that it was nothing especially constructive.

Data:Acted.zachary.wound.winter.json.label: Acted: Zachary
Data:Acted.zachary.wound.winter.json.desc: Zachary Wakefield regretted that the Open Reverend would only open outwards... but expressed relief that 'his suffering need not be drawn out any longer.'
